createAndInitialize(uint256[],address[],.details: Creates and initializes a new OpenAccount instance. Deploys a minimal ERC-1967 proxy clone using CREATE2 for deterministic addresses. The proxy delegates all calls to the implementation contract and maintains its own storage. If an account at the predicted address already exists, returns that address without redeploying.

implementation().details: Returns the OpenAccount implementation contract address. This is the logic contract that all created proxy clones will delegate to.

predictAddress(uint256[],address[],bytes.details: Predicts the address of an OpenAccount before it is created. The address is deterministically computed based on the initialization parameters and salt. Each account is deployed as an ERC-1967 proxy clone.
